_comment: Auto-Rig Pro rig exported through Sketchfab. Two things make it need this file.
1. Bone naming. ARP calls the upper arm 'arm' and the forearm 'forearm', and
buries the deforming bones among ~70 IK/FK/twist/pole controls per arm. The
automatic matcher picked 'headband01' for the head and missed both upper arms.
2. A flattened hierarchy. The bones that actually carry skin weight -
arm_stretch, forearm_stretch, hand - are parented to 'c_traj_02', a single
trajectory node, not to each other. In Blender the chain is held together by
constraints, and constraints do not survive glTF export. Without the
chain_parents below, rotating the upper arm leaves the forearm behind.
The upper arm is twist-split: c_arm_twist_offset covers the shoulder half and
pivots at the true shoulder joint, arm_stretch covers the elbow half. We aim the
first and let the second inherit.
Node names come from `check_avatar.py`, which lists them.
